# Felipe Ribeiro

> Felipe Ribeiro (felipefrf.com) is an AI engineer based in São Paulo, Brazil. He is a founding engineer at Hexagon (joinhexagon.com), building Milo, the founder of MedAlvo, and an aerospace engineering student (data science minor) at Instituto Tecnológico de Aeronáutica (ITA), expected to graduate in December 2027. He builds LLM agents for production settings where wrong answers are expensive.

## Work

- Hexagon, Founding Engineer (Sep 2026 to now, San Francisco, remote): building Milo, a peer-to-peer personal AI for teams where each employee's agent runs in its own Linux microVM. Teams and Google Chat integrations, a credential vault for the hosted browser agent, eval-first shipping.
- NG.CASH, Product Engineer (Jan 2026 to Sep 2026, São Paulo, remote): WhatsApp debt-negotiation agent with deterministic pricing in code (0 leaks across a 34-attack prompt-injection battery), payroll re-platform on GCP Cloud Run, judicial-notification triage automation.
- Credix, ML Engineer, Credit & Risk (Jul 2025 to Jan 2026, remote): XGBoost and logistic-regression credit models in production.
- Earlier: Safra (US Equities Summer Intern, 2025), BTG Pactual (Automation Engineer Intern, 2024), XP Inc. (Product Control Summer Intern, 2023–24).
- LinkedIn, Sales Strategy Intern, Data & AI (Feb 2025 to Jul 2025, remote): LLM chatbot over Salesforce CRM data for US & Canada sales forecasting.

## Projects

- AI chief of staff (personal, 2026): a Claude Code session on his server reads WhatsApp (read-only, allow-listed contacts), Slack, three Gmail accounts, Granola, calendar, Drive and GitHub every 15 minutes; prepares replies, e-mails, the daily agenda and background Claude sessions ("lanes") that open PRs; everything is approved from an Android PWA with push, and approved WhatsApp messages are sent from the Mac and confirmed in the chat database. Voice notes are transcribed on the Mac with whisper; drafts can be adjusted or discarded with a reason, and every reason becomes a lesson. Nightly learning with Claude batches writes memory of people, projects and his writing style.

- [Curo](https://felipefrf.com/curo/): WhatsApp-first patient-care layer for Brazilian specialists and clinics (Google ADK, Gemini, Postgres). The clinic describes its process in plain language and the agent authors the care journey (steps, dependencies, deadlines); moving a surgery date re-plans the case (dependent steps fall, undo work opens, deadlines recompute). LGPD built in (audit of every read, art. 18 deletion); 973 tests. A part-time project with his brother that went as far as a Y Combinator interview. A clickable demo of the clinic portal (made-up data) is at https://felipefrf.com/curo/painel/.
- [Flight Price Finder](https://felipefrf.com/flights/) (side project; the link is a static replay of four real recorded searches): finds the cheapest routes including hidden-city fares (a ticket to a further city that connects where you want to land), using Google Flights fares; real example: SSA→CGH direct R$381 vs SSA→CGH→FLN R$248.
- [Ápice](https://software-house-six.vercel.app): software house he runs on the side with his brother (ITA + MIT); clients include Império Eventos (logistics control tower and field app).
- Império Logística (client work through Ápice, 2026): for Império Eventos, an events rental company in São Paulo, a control tower (Next.js) and an Android field app (Expo) on Supabase, reading orders from the EstoqueNOW rental ERP every 15 minutes. The field app walks each crew leader through the day one step per screen (departure, travel, arrival, setup, event, teardown, return) with photos, GPS, geofences and signatures, and works offline. The office side shows every truck on a live map with a traffic-aware arrival forecast, alerts the bosses on their phones, keeps the week's bookings, adds up what is owed to each person (daily rates, overtime, hotel, meals) and each event's margin. First meeting to production in about 11 weeks.
- [MedAlvo](https://medalvo.com.br): adaptive prep company for Brazilian medical residency exams that he founded and runs on the side; it makes money. 189,157 questions from official exams across 334 institutions, 99.7% with a commented solution checked against the official answer key. Engine: FSRS v6, Thompson Sampling, 2PL IRT, Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (FastAPI, Postgres 17/pgvector, Cloud Run, React). Ships on the web, as an Android app (a Trusted Web Activity with a home-screen widget and Google Play Billing, submitted to Google Play) and as a remote MCP connector for Claude and ChatGPT with its own OAuth 2.1 server and 18 study tools. AI agents in cloud VMs extract, deduplicate and check the question bank.
- [penpad](https://github.com/felipefrf/penpad): open-source tool that turns Markdown + LaTeX notes into realistic handwritten PDF/PNG pages for tablets. Project page: https://felipefrf.com/penpad/
- [Editable Pets](https://github.com/felipefrf/editable-pets): macOS desktop companion for Claude Code and Codex sessions.
- [yt-to-md](https://github.com/felipefrf/yt-to-md): YouTube video to structured Markdown for AI agents, no API key.
- [dual-subtitles-extension](https://github.com/felipefrf/dual-subtitles-extension): Chrome extension with two synced subtitle languages on YouTube.
- [x-reset](https://github.com/felipefrf/x-reset): bulk-delete old tweets from an official X archive.

## The site

The home page hero is a live orbital simulation (RK4 with the J2 term) of Matsumoto-2, the SAR satellite concept his ITA team designed, modelled in Blender and rendered with three.js. The olympiad medals are Blender models rendered live in the browser (drag to turn them).

## Leadership

- President, ITA Jobs Commission (2023–2024): ran Brazil's largest countryside career fair, 1,800+ attendees.
- Co-founder, Iniciativa Feynman (2019–2021): 81 volunteers, 350+ public-school students taught for free during COVID.
- Multiplicador, Fundação Estudar (2024).
